en: Multi-view color postcard showing the medieval town and citadel of Sighișoara: panoramic hillsides with red-roofed houses, several fortified towers and walls, cobbled streets and a square seen through an arch. The iconic Clock Tower dominates multiple views. A red banner with yellow letters reads "SIGHIȘOARA" on the front; the back has Romanian postcard layout and publisher details.
